name: rental-edge-functions
description: Serverless backend for a short-term rental business on Cloudflare Pages Functions: Airbnb iCal parsing, a public availability API, token-to-cookie guest access and Cloudflare Access JWT verification.

scripts.dev:guests: cd guests && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev public --port 8788
scripts.dev:staff: cd staff && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev public --port 8789
